# Pre-market brief — Wed 2026-11-25 (~8:30 AM ET)

1. **Tech selloff gets worse; futures sharply lower.** As of ~8:00 ET: ES −1.9%, NQ −2.8%, YM −1.3% ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-november-25-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-pce-inflation-data-091428237.html)). At 8:01, QQQ was −2.89% and about 74% of Monday's gain was gone. MU was −6.8%, NVDA −5.6% and AMD −5.9%, putting AMD below its Friday close ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-25-2026)). The AI-hardware group avoid holds.
2. **Tariffs.** The US is preparing Section 301 tariffs on China, the EU, Japan, Korea and more than 12 others. They would replace the levies struck down in February and broadly restore 2025 levels. Timing and rates are not confirmed ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/25/us-tariffs-trump-section-301.html), [OCBC](https://www.ocbc.com/iwov-resources/sg/ocbc/gbc/pdf/daily%20treasury%20outlook/2026/dto%20251126.pdf)). This is an inflation risk for importers and retailers, and it touches our open DLTR, BBY, TGT and TJX holds.
3. **Macro at 8:30:** Oct PCE and Q3 GDP (2nd estimate) ([BEA](https://www.bea.gov/news/schedule)). Core PCE is expected at 3.2% y/y, and Dec hike odds are ~98% ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-november-25-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-pce-inflation-data-091428237.html)). Results were not out when this was written. Beige Book is at 2:00. Thursday is closed and Friday is a 1:00 PM half day.
4. **Rates, oil, BTC:** 10-yr 4.91%, 2-yr 4.63%; WTI +2.3% to $82.05, Brent $91.40 on Hormuz risk ([OCBC](https://www.ocbc.com/iwov-resources/sg/ocbc/gbc/pdf/daily%20treasury%20outlook/2026/dto%20251126.pdf)). BTC ~$59.3k, down ~1% ([Reuters/Investing](https://au.investing.com/news/economy-news/stocks-retreat-as-ai-rebound-stumbles-tariff-threats-loom-4794566)).
5. **DE:** Q4 EPS $3.89 vs ~$4.03–4.07 est, revenue $12.1B (−2%). FY27 net income guide is $4.5–5.25B, below ~$5.9–6.1B est ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/315189/000110465926131741/de-ex99d1.htm), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/deere-stock-slides-as-q4-earnings-miss-estimates-despite-revenue-beat-5050377), [Qz](https://qz.com/deere-profit-outlook-fiscal-2027-earnings-112526)). It was −3.4% at 6:34 ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-25-2026)). Avoid.
6. **Movers:** WDAY ~−10% and DELL −5% to −7% despite its guide ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/movers/26/11/63618715/ambarella-posts-downbeat-q3-results-joins-workday-dell-and-other-big-stocks-moving-lower-in-wednesdays-pre-market-session), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nvidia-chipmakers-slide-premarket-dell-falls-despite-upbeat-outlook-5050581)). AMBA −35% on its guide; NTNX −13% on a CEO exit ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-25-2026)).
7. **Earnings ahead:** CRM 12/2 AMC (in avoid).

## Swing ideas
None new. This is a risk-off open with −2% to −3% index gaps, on a session after a shock bounce and ahead of a holiday (lessons 11/06, 10/23). Existing holds are unchanged. Retail holds now carry tariff risk.
